source_authority: University Grants Commission — list of State Universities (live table behind the UGC website, all rows)

fields.ugc_id: UGC's internal row ID in the live table (stable key for re-fetching; not an AISHE code)
fields.status: as UGC prints it: 2(f) / 2(f) & 12B for state and private universities, Section-III (deemed under Section 3 of the UGC Act) for deemed universities; 'Category-I/II' = graded autonomy
fields.has_12b: derived from status: eligible for central (UGC) grants under Section 12B
fields.zip/url: null where UGC leaves them blank

excluded: Vice-chancellor, registrar and nodal-officer names, phone numbers and e-mails (null in the public feed anyway) and all audit fields are deliberately left out: institution-level fields only.
note: UGC's 'State Universities' list mixes general, technical, health-science, agricultural/veterinary, law (NLUs), sports, open and skill universities run by state governments. Wave D batches (D1-D6) should all pick their rows from this one list.
